annotation: No task labels, human reviews, LLM labels or learner head. The membership basis e_v is a deterministic original-panel index coordinate, not a supervised target.

checks.each_checkpoint: Apply the same cumulative prefix as one batch and as the reversed singleton sequence; require full snapshot equality. Recompute the retained-feature graph with block size 37; require its direct selection and independently assembled polynomial state to equal the repaired state at the remaining horizon.
checks.every_singleton: Exact selected membership against an independent original raw-blocker predicate; state invariants and operation-count bounds.
checks.full_fresh_recuration: Recompute the retained score graph at every registered checkpoint; no cached selected-ID oracle.
checks.record_and_source_priorities: Stable ID-derived original seed 0; never reorder relative priorities after deletion.
checks.scope: Exact curation membership and generic polynomial state only; no supervised utility, native ridge certification or service performance claim.

data_scope: Same original pre-guard whole-source development-training prefix as Stage 1; other held-out feature slices and all labels stay unread.
failure_policy: Any mismatch, source change, timeout, cap refusal or missing cut is an explicit failure; preserve partial outputs. No automatic retry or cutoff selection. An empty request frame remains unavailable.
limits: Only one R and one S trajectory per cutoff: correctness cases, not deployment prevalence estimates
Membership-basis storage is not a compact-payload or native-learner benchmark
Harness oracles have private inputs; no kernel-enforced no-reaccess claim
No new semantic threshold selected or validated
next: Separately versioned original native-label development is required for learner, head and utility comparisons. No automatic downstream launch.
prior_exposure: v3 90 canonical pairs no joint positives
v4 all51 cuts failed19/20 joint-positive gate; maximum2/5
v4 invalid outputs and swaps already inspected
All prior calibration and historical lexical engineering evidence retained; design chosen after those results
publication: Aggregate counts, check booleans, operation meters, timing receipts and input/source bindings only. No request IDs, record/source IDs, memberships, states, embeddings, labels or raw text exported.
relation_to_original: Run original exact generic IndexedState implementation on real fixed E5 graphs with deterministic membership statistics. Separate postnegative development; original failed semantic and human gates retained.

request_protocol.frame_shortfall: Use the original generator clipped horizon and checkpoints; an empty frame is explicitly unavailable. No replacement.
request_protocol.source_frame: Only original native contributor proxy source units, excluding unknown singleton units.

resource_limits.nfs_scope: Existing private inputs read only; scheduler logs and sanitized aggregates only. Root wrapper must prospectively bind fresh quota check and explicit separate small-output policy. Original remote8GiBstagegate remains unchanged.
resource_limits.temporary_output_filesystem: fresh compute-node scratch; must have8GiBreserve before/through execution

score_rule: Strict score > original floating cut; unchanged Phase 3 ordered FP64 graph source; all 51 cuts regardless of Stage 1 outcomes.
stage1_dependency: Only prior input, scorer and runtime admission can be reused; no Stage 1 count, activation or favorable finding is a launch gate.

state_contract.comparison: All logical coefficient, index, alive-unit and horizon snapshots exactly equal; no physical byte canonicality claim
state_contract.horizon: 128 or the original generator frame clipping; decrement for newly deleted units, never replenish
state_contract.retry: Frozen IndexedState idempotent retry contract; do not conflate it with the strict service API
state_contract.source_term: e_v*(1-x_owner(v))*product over distinct blocker-source deletion variables; an own-source blocker makes the term identically zero
state_contract.source_universe: All original-panel source units including unknown units; requests sample only genuine sources
state_contract.statistics: Exact integer original-panel membership basis e_v, dimension 1001
